title: Textbook → Code Missing Link (Nutritional Laws for KIBO)
thesis: Textbooks already contain laws (homeostasis, interactions, digestion bounds). They do not package them for a code system: System category, organ, subsystem, gate vs bound, typed relations, meal/host conditions. This file is that missing link.
sources_of_shape: GROK_laws.md (JSON law objects, governingSystems, boundsAndConditions, pathwayDetails, appApplications)

METABOLIC_HOMEOSTASIS_01.missing_for_code: Which KIBO system? Gate vs bound? What is the executable edge?
METABOLIC_HOMEOSTASIS_01.our_fill: Protein-stat, appetite dual-loop, cholesterol pool, Fe U-curve = concrete controllers with bounds
